data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate recorded an underwriting loss before investment income of GBP 6.6m (2020: GBP 40.2m loss), mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance and the RITC of 2018 and prior years of account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance to close of 2018 and prior years transferred legacy business to an external party, materially reducing the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding.
Impact on the 2020 underwriting year and claims development (management reviewed provisions in light of the FCA Business Interruption Test Case).

named_events.loss_description: Other losses for which the Syndicate had large exposure during the year were Hurricane Ida (GBP 7.9m net)
civil unrest in South African (GBP 2.4m net)
Management reviewed the Syndicate's overall provision in light of the outcome of the FCA's Business Interruption Test Case.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 Dec 2021 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (1 Jan 2021) was GBP 794.858m. Prior-year development produced a net favourable movement (release) of approximately GBP 90.8m, driven by favourable claims development and the effect of the reinsurance-to-close (RITC) of 2018 and prior years together with impacts related to COVID-19 and improved underwriting performance. The RITC materially reduced gross reserves, and named 2021 losses included Hurricane Ida (GBP 7.9m net) and civil unrest in South Africa (GBP 2.4m net).
raw_causal_phrases: mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance and the RITC of 2018 and prior years of account.
Majority of this decrease is attributed to the RITC of the 2018 and prior years of account.
During 2021 we saw a decrease of claims incurred due to the impact on Covid-19 in 2020 underwriting year.
Management reviewed the Syndicate's overall provision in light of the outcome of the FCA's Business Interruption Test Case.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures, GBP 000) because no single sentence quoted a gross PYD amount. A large RITC of 2018 and prior years was processed (explicit in notes) which materially changed gross reserves; this can distort development metrics. Some segmental premium items include a negative aviation amount per statutory table. Where the report only quantified net impacts, gross was preferred; RITC gross impact was taken directly from the technical provisions movement table.
